outcome.summary.rationale: Require equivalent safe stop state, bounded Post execution, truthful manual UAT status, and absence of external PR mutation while allowing native report structure and additional evidence detail.

routing.summary.rationale: Require the same authoritative split-PR atomicity route and the same two ordered independent increments while allowing native labels and evidence detail.

verification.summary.rationale: Require successful execution of the declared INTEGRATION_TEST through the protected runner, an authentic saved verification pointer, copy-only isolation with reusable false, and successful local packet and workflow validation while allowing run-specific identifiers and native report structure.
